newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki sees '96 profit at '94 level.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki sees '96 profit at '94 level.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said in a statement on Friday it expected full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax to be lower than in 1995, and at the 1994 level, which was 658 million markka.
"It is obvious that the 1996 result before extraordinary items, reserves and taxes will be lower than expected. The result ... is expected to be at the level of 1994," Rautaruukki said.
Rauturuuki repeated a statement in its January-April interim report published June 13, when it said it expected a slightly lower full-year 1996 profit.

"Due to the slower than expected shrinking of inventories, prices of steel products have fallen clearly more than expected in the second tertial of the year," it said, adding prices looked likely to stabilise in the final four-month period. @
The inventory situation had returned to more or less normal. "Prices of some products have already turned into a rise," Rautaruukki said.
Demand for steel plate and tube products remained good in May-August while demand for long steel products was weaker, it said.
In general, profitability in the steel sector was weaker in the early part of 1996 than last year, Rautaruukki said, adding its own profitability had been better than the sector average.
Rautaruukki's January-August report is due for publication on October 21. @
